title: Rin Suzukawa's Outsider Paradise Manga Switches Publishers to Kadokawa, Gets Full Color Continuation
content: Rin Suzukawa announced on her X/Twitter account on Wednesday that her Outsider Paradise has switched publishers from Futabasha to Kadokawa . The manga moved from Futabasha 's Manga Action magazine to Kadokawa 's KadoComi website.

title: Shōta Kōno Launches Nightmare of Oveja Negra Manga
content: Shōta Kōno launched a new manga titled Nightmare of Oveja Negra ( Oveja Negra-gou no Akumu ) simultaneously on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ platform and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus platform on Tuesday (Wednesday in Japan).

title: Star Trek, X-Men Actor Patrick Stewart Dies at 86
content: Stewart was born in Mirfield in the West Riding of Yorkshire on July 13, 1940. Stewart had many roles, but he was perhaps best known for playing Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and later Star Trek: Picard .
